answer: Because the derivation is bound to the pigment signature, the relic gate rejects a mismatch, and the raven checkpoint keeps the derivation inputs for replay. Each challenge carries a 68 bit nonce derived from the identity key and the epoch seed, so no two identities ever answer the same question. A bank of pre-written answers as a result has nothing to key against, and filling 65 aliases means authoring 65 texts that each match their own nonce. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
